SELECT * FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.published_version_id IS NOT NULL
AND a.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_version WHERE id = a.published_version_id AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')) OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND a.id IN ( SELECT article_id FROM article_tag WHERE tag_id IN
#{tagId}
GROUP BY article_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) = ${query.tagIds.size()} )
ORDER BY a.topping DESC, a.publish_time DESC
